name: facet
description: Gerenciador local de perfis de navegador com proxy, fingerprint, cookies e extensões por perfil.
author: Facet

scripts.dev: node scripts/make-icon.mjs && node scripts/build-win-helper.mjs && node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && node scripts/fetch-ungoogled-chromium.mjs && electron-vite dev
scripts.build: node scripts/make-icon.mjs && node scripts/build-win-helper.mjs && electron-vite build
scripts.pack: node scripts/make-icon.mjs && node scripts/build-win-helper.mjs && node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && node scripts/fetch-ungoogled-chromium.mjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: node scripts/make-icon.mjs && node scripts/build-win-helper.mjs && node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && node scripts/fetch-ungoogled-chromium.mjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.start: node scripts/make-icon.mjs && node scripts/build-win-helper.mjs && node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && node scripts/fetch-ungoogled-chromium.mjs && electron-vite preview
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit --composite false && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json --noEmit --composite false
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/make-icon.mjs && node scripts/build-win-helper.mjs && node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && node scripts/fetch-ungoogled-chromium.mjs && electron-vite build && playwright test
scripts.docs:images: node scripts/make-icon.mjs && node scripts/build-win-helper.mjs && node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && node scripts/fetch-ungoogled-chromium.mjs && electron-vite build && playwright test -c playwright.docs.config.ts
